columns.comment: Calendar month of the month-end snapshot as its first day (DATE): September 2026 = DATE'2026-09-01' (the month-end snapshot as of 30-Sep-2026). This view is monthly; point-in-time measures grouped by a longer period (quarter, half, fiscal year) return its last month. The latest month is Sep 2026.
columns.name: Month

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal year label of the month-end snapshot, April to March: FY2026 = Apr 2026 - Mar 2027, FY2025 = Apr 2025 - Mar 2026. "This year" / YTD = FY2026 to 30-Sep-2026; year-on-year compares the same months of FY2025.
columns.name: Fiscal Year

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal quarter label, e.g. FY2026-Q2: Q1 = Apr-Jun, Q2 = Jul-Sep, Q3 = Oct-Dec, Q4 = Jan-Mar (FY2026-Q4 = Jan-Mar 2027). The latest quarter is FY2026-Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026).
columns.name: Fiscal Quarter

columns.comment: Japanese fiscal half label, e.g. FY2026-H1: H1 = Apr-Sep, H2 = Oct-Mar. H1 FY2026 (Apr-Sep 2026) closed on 30-Sep-2026; compare with FY2025-H1 for year-on-year.
columns.name: Fiscal Half

columns.comment: Always true here: this view is monthly, every row is a month-end snapshot or a whole-month total (kept so the same filter works in daily and monthly views).
columns.name: Is Month End

columns.comment: True for September 2026, the latest (as-of) month - use it for "today", "current", "latest" or "right now" questions on balances and other point-in-time measures.
columns.name: Is Latest Month

columns.comment: Client group = the global parent group, as its short brand (e.g. Kinokawa Precision, Hayashi Marine Logistics). "Client" or "group" without qualification means this level. Match with LIKE '%Kinokawa%'.
columns.name: Client Group

columns.comment: The group's lead (relationship) legal entity, e.g. the entity holding the account plan.
columns.name: Lead Client

columns.comment: Group segment (most common segment of its APAC clients): Japanese Corporate, Non-Japanese Large Corporate, Financial Institution, Sponsor & Structured Finance or Public Sector.
columns.name: Segment

columns.comment: Group relationship tier - Strategic, Core or Transactional. "Strategic groups" means Relationship Tier = Strategic.
columns.name: Relationship Tier

columns.comment: True for groups headquartered in Japan (Japanese corporate groups) - "Japanese corporates" / "JC" means true.
columns.name: Is Japanese Corporate

columns.comment: Group industry sector (most common sector of its APAC clients), e.g. Technology, Materials, Energy.
columns.name: Industry

columns.comment: Group industry subsector (most common subsector of its APAC clients), e.g. Automotive Parts, Shipping.
columns.name: Subsector

columns.comment: Lead office of the group = coverage office of its lead entity, ISO-2 code (SG Singapore, HK Hong Kong, CN China, TH Thailand, ID Indonesia, IN India, AU Australia, VN Vietnam, MY Malaysia, KR South Korea, TW Taiwan, PH Philippines, NZ New Zealand).
columns.name: Coverage Office

columns.comment: Group lead RM = current primary RM of the group's lead entity (fictional name).
columns.name: Primary RM

columns.comment: Office (APAC booking location, ISO-2) where the group lead RM sits - "RMs in Singapore" means this.
columns.name: Primary RM Office

columns.comment: Worst (highest) internal rating grade 1-10 among the group's rated APAC clients today; null = no rated client.
columns.name: Rating Grade

columns.comment: Highest IFRS 9 stage (1-3) among the group's APAC clients today.
columns.name: IFRS 9 Stage

columns.comment: True when at least one APAC client of the group is on the credit watchlist today.
columns.name: Watchlist

columns.comment: KYC / AML risk rating (Low, Medium, High) of the group's lead entity today; null = no KYC record.
columns.name: KYC Risk Rating

columns.comment: Worst current early-warning band among the group's APAC clients (Red > Amber > Green); null = none scored.
columns.name: EWS Band

columns.comment: Row type: Structure member (a header or participant account of a cash pool at the month-end) or Group (one row per client group: its deposits, APAC footprint and pooling status). Each measure reads its own type.
columns.name: Record Type

columns.comment: Notional Pooling, Physical Pooling, Sweep or Interest Optimisation (Structure member rows).
columns.name: Structure Type

columns.comment: Liquidity structure (cash pool) id, e.g. LQS-0003 (Structure member rows).
columns.name: Structure

columns.comment: Booking country of the structure's header (master) account, ISO-2 - where the pool is run from.
columns.name: Header Country

columns.comment: Booking country of the member account (header or participant), ISO-2.
columns.name: Participant Country

columns.comment: Currency of the member account (ISO 4217); balances are converted to USD at month-end FX.
columns.name: Currency

columns.comment: Header (the master account; one per structure) or Participant (Structure member rows).
columns.name: Member Role

columns.comment: Legal entity (golden client) holding the member account, as it was at the month-end (Structure member rows).
columns.name: Member Entity

columns.comment: Number of APAC booking countries in which the client group holds deposit accounts at the month-end (Group rows) - 3 or more = multi-country group, a pooling candidate when it has no active structure.
columns.name: Group APAC Countries

columns.comment: True on Group rows for multi-country groups (accounts in >= 3 APAC countries, dim_threshold POOLING_MIN_COUNTRIES) with no active liquidity structure at the month-end - the pooling cross-sell list.
columns.name: Is Pooling Candidate

columns.comment: Liquidity structures active at the month-end (point-in-time; last month-end of the selection).
columns.name: Structures

columns.comment: Participant accounts in the structures at the month-end, header accounts excluded (point-in-time).
columns.name: Participants

columns.comment: Month-end balance of all accounts in the structures (header + participants) in USD (point-in-time; never a sum of months).
columns.name: Pooled Balance USD

columns.comment: Estimated interest saved / earned thanks to the structures = member balance x the structure's interest benefit (bps) / 12, summed over the selected months (a flow; an estimate).
columns.name: Interest Saved USD

columns.comment: Monthly liquidity-structure fees charged to clients, summed over the selected months (a flow; header rows).
columns.name: Structure Fees USD

columns.comment: Total month-end deposits of the client groups across all their APAC accounts, USD (Group rows; point-in-time).
columns.name: Group Deposits USD

columns.comment: Client groups with accounts in >= 3 APAC countries and no active liquidity structure at the month-end - the pooling cross-sell list (point-in-time). Rank them by Unpooled Group Deposits USD.
columns.name: Clients Without Pooling

columns.comment: Month-end deposits of the multi-country groups without an active structure, USD (point-in-time).
columns.name: Unpooled Group Deposits USD

columns.comment: Client groups with deposit accounts in >= 3 APAC countries at the month-end (POOLING_MIN_COUNTRIES; point-in-time).
columns.name: Multi-Country Groups

columns.comment: Multi-country groups (>= 3 APAC countries) running at least one active liquidity structure at the month-end.
columns.name: Multi-Country Groups With Pooling

columns.comment: Share of multi-country groups that run an active liquidity structure (fraction, at the month-end).
columns.name: Pooling Penetration %

comment: Liquidity structures (cash pools) of SMBC's APAC client groups at each month-end, Apr-2023 to Sep-2026: number of structures (notional / physical pooling, sweeps, interest optimisation), participant accounts, pooled balance, estimated interest saved and structure fees, by structure type, header country, participant country and currency - plus the pooling cross-sell list: multi-country groups (accounts in >= 3 APAC countries) without any active structure, with their total deposits. Balances and counts are POINT-IN-TIME: filter one Month (Is Latest Month = Sep 2026); a longer period returns its last month-end. Interest saved and fees are monthly flows. Grain: one row per structure member account per month-end, plus one row per client group per month-end (gold.mvb_group_liquidity).
